'''Warlan Presvere Tosk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Tosk was from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and he gained employment as a guard on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Cularin, was set to return to the world on a visit, and along with the guard [[Gibbs (shape-shifter)|Gibbs]], Tosk prepared the security arrangements for her trip. Tosk [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[veshet]], which he correctly deduced had been sent to attack Wren, and he ordered extra security precautions to be taken. Discouraged, Gibbs, who unknown to Tosk was an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] hired to kill Wren, decided that Tosk was too competant to make a mistake, and so chose not to murder Wren during her visit.<ref name="Insecurities" />

Wren was later imprisoned on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the Republic, and Tosk freed her and delivered to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] a recording in which Wren declared that the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] was seceding from the Republic. The pair then escaped from Coruscant in a stolen [[Starship/Legends|starship]], while coming under attack from [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The [[Office of Republic Justice]] subsequently placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on Tosk.<ref name="Home Again">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20051208HomeAgain|text=Home Again|int=Home Again}}</ref>
